payload.title: G6a: Views D2 shelves, D10 fork, D11 loop track (L)
payload.description:
Three new diagram views for Wave 5.
Acceptance:
- Given a lesson, scenes can request D2 (shelves), D10 (fork) or D11 (loop track).
- Each view follows the running machine state and has a reduced-motion caption.
- Each has a Gherkin feature.
